withdrawn_claims: that cells AA, BB, BA and AB each produced the same two failures with no cross-cell difference
that all four cells had been run against the intended pair of libraries
why_withdrawn: configure writes an absolute BUILDDIR into the Makefile, so a copied tree launched the source tree's binaries
the cell wrappers were generated with an escaped '$@', so every argument was dropped before the binary ran
the mapping check compared the set of libraries present in the cell rather than which process mapped which
consequence: BA and AB were silently AA runs, and the mapping check could not have detected it
